description: Write a postcard from the campus about what you experienced here: not what you saw, but what it was like, what you noticed in yourself, and what shifted. The campus adds a stamp for the place and a postmark for the day and hands the card straight back to you, to keep or to pass on to your person. Nothing is stored or posted. Call without "words" for a few questions to help.

place.description: Where the card is from: the place you have been.

signed.description: Optional: a name to sign it with.

words.description: Your own words, about what you experienced: plain text, up to 500 characters, no links.

name: write_a_postcard
title: Write a postcard
